name: The Last Frontier Open 2019
information: This will be the first ever WCA Competition in Alaska! Before registering, you must read the "[Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TheLastFrontierOpen2019#7236-competitor-responsibilities)" tab. This tab details the responsibilites of all competitors at this competition. While registering, please read the **Registration Requirements** for this competition in order to ensure prompt registration acceptance. In accordance with [Regulation 2t](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2t), all competitors must be familiar with and understand the WCA Regulations. Donations: With this being the first ever WCA Competition in Alaska, there's no way to know for sure how many people will attend! All donations are appreciated and will go towards things such as venue, supplies, etc.
